name: @secdogie/symbiont
description: secdogie operator page: one calm column attached to your node over WebRTC; dual Socratic gates; state-graph library over Rust-WASM

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
